
          patch_relative=".github/patches/cut3r-curope-torch211-cu126.patch"
          patch_path="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$patch_relative"
          kernels_relative="src/croco/models/curope/kernels.cu"
          setup_relative="src/croco/models/curope/setup.py"
          kernels="$checkout/$kernels_relative"
          setup="$checkout/$setup_relative"
          test -f "$patch_path"
          test "$(/usr/bin/git rev-parse "HEAD:$patch_relative")" = \
            "9127464c77b571b9586144cabe24a4eed8667db0"
          test "$(sha256sum "$patch_path" | awk '{print $1}')" = \
            "9778ec434a6e2d9ae8be162295d60e06d86bf0fbadbb66d516eb46c666ab547d"
          test "$(/usr/bin/git -C "$checkout" rev-parse "HEAD:$kernels_relative")" = \
            "7156cd1bb935cb1f0be45e58add53f9c21505c20"
          test "$(/usr/bin/git -C "$checkout" rev-parse "HEAD:$setup_relative")" = \
            "02ddb0912370a67a49fd2bb91164cf2f1da8648e"
          /usr/bin/git -C "$checkout" apply --check "$patch_path"
          /usr/bin/git -C "$checkout" apply "$patch_path"
          /usr/bin/git -C "$checkout" diff --check
          mapfile -t patched_paths < <(
            /usr/bin/git -C "$checkout" diff --name-only | sort
          )
          test "${#patched_paths[@]}" -eq 2
          test "${patched_paths[0]}" = "$kernels_relative"
          test "${patched_paths[1]}" = "$setup_relative"
          grep -F 'tokens.scalar_type()' "$kernels"
          ! grep -F 'tokens.type()' "$kernels"
          grep -F 'arch=compute_89,code=sm_89' "$setup"

          PATCH_PATH="$patch_path" \
            KERNELS_PATH="$kernels" \
            SETUP_PATH="$setup" \
            OUTPUT_PATH="$root/evidence/curope-build-compatibility.json" \
            "$RUNTIME_PYTHON" - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          patch = Path(os.environ["PATCH_PATH"])
          kernels = Path(os.environ["KERNELS_PATH"])
          setup = Path(os.environ["SETUP_PATH"])
          receipt = {
              "schema": "prob4d.dot-r04-r10-curope-build-compatibility",
              "schema_version": 1,
              "cut3r_revision": os.environ["CUT3R_REVISION"],
              "compatibility_patch": (
                  ".github/patches/cut3r-curope-torch211-cu126.patch"
              ),
              "compatibility_patch_git_blob_sha1": (
                  "9127464c77b571b9586144cabe24a4eed8667db0"
              ),
              "compatibility_patch_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                  patch.read_bytes()
              ).hexdigest(),
              "source_git_blob_sha1": {
                  "src/croco/models/curope/kernels.cu": (
                      "7156cd1bb935cb1f0be45e58add53f9c21505c20"
                  ),
                  "src/croco/models/curope/setup.py": (
                      "02ddb0912370a67a49fd2bb91164cf2f1da8648e"
                  ),
              },
              "patched_sha256": {
                  "src/croco/models/curope/kernels.cu": hashlib.sha256(
                      kernels.read_bytes()
                  ).hexdigest(),
                  "src/croco/models/curope/setup.py": hashlib.sha256(
                      setup.read_bytes()
                  ).hexdigest(),
              },
              "cuda_target": "compute_89/sm_89",
              "pytorch_dispatch_api": "tokens.scalar_type()",
              "information_boundary": {
                  "dot_payload_opened": False,
                  "provider_prediction_run": False,
                  "marker_payload_opened": False,
                  "scientific_inputs_changed": False,
              },
          }
          encoded = json.dumps(
              receipt,
              sort_keys=True,
              separators=(",", ":"),
          ).encode("utf-8")
          receipt["artifact_id"] = hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
          Path(os.environ["OUTPUT_PATH"]).write_text(
              json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
              encoding="utf-8",
          )
          PY
